data.content_ref: inline:The 'Redundancy Paradox' (SRC_003) abstracts the specific failure modes of 'Synchronization Resonance' (SRC_005) and 'Coordination Complexity' (SRC_004) into a general principle where internal redundancy eventually yields diminishing returns on resilience. This relation is refuted if there exists a form of internal redundancy that does not rely on a coordination layer and does not trigger resonance.
